claim_text: Micronutrient deficiency interventions in sub-Saharan Africa are influenced by various factors, including coverage and inequities, which may affect their overall effectiveness.

sources.relevant_chunk: The effectiveness of micronutrient interventions varies across different contexts and populations.

claim_text: There are varying levels of coverage in micronutrient interventions across different life stages in sub-Saharan Africa, with higher coverage during pregnancy and lower coverage during infancy and young childhood.

sources.source_title: Nutrition Intervention Coverage and Inequities Along the Continuum of Care: Results From the Eighth Demographic and Health Survey in Six Sub‐Saharan African Countries
sources.relevant_chunk: Coverage was highest during pregnancy and lowest during infancy and young childhood.
